title: Camacho - My Mind
htmlContent:
Camacho is going headfirst into the music industry, starting with releasing his newest single, “My Mind.” Camacho takes us into his world by unleashing the latest single, “My Mind,” available on all streaming outlets. 

“My Mind” sets the tone further regarding what audiences can expect from him. He seeks the hidden truths of today’s world. “My Mind” pulls on all those characteristics and builds a visual record. Camacho is an artist you should be on the lookout for. 

Camacho’s “My Mind” is currently on all streaming platforms.
